Executes the REAL EncodedFile class source from the repo file (AST-extracted,
no _pytest imports -- the 2019 codebase needs stdlib 'imp', gone in 3.12).
Compares HEAD (bug) vs working tree (fix) with youtube-dl's exact decision
rule: 'b' in out.mode -> write bytes, else write str.

import io
import sys

CAPTURE = "src/_pytest/capture.py"
COMPAT = "src/_pytest/compat.py"
HEAD_CAPTURE = "C:/Windows/Temp/capture_head.py"  # written by the shell from git show HEAD


def extract(path, name):
    """Pull a top-level ClassDef or Assign (by target name) out of a file."""
    tree = ast.parse(open(path).read())
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == name:
            return node
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            for t in node.targets:
                if isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == name:
                    return node
    raise SystemExit("not found in %s: %s" % (path, name))


def load_class(capture_path):
    mod = ast.Module(
        body=[
            ast.Import(names=[ast.alias(name="six", asname=None)]),
            extract(COMPAT, "_PY3"),
            extract(capture_path, "EncodedFile"),
        ],
        type_ignores=[],
    )
    ast.fix_missing_locations(mod)
    ns = {"__name__": "verify_5262"}
    exec(compile(mod, capture_path, "exec"), ns)
    return ns["EncodedFile"]


def scenario(EncodedFile, label):
    buf = io.open("/dev/null", "rb+")  # underlying binary temp stream
    f = EncodedFile(buf, "UTF8")

    payload = b"binary-log" if "b" in mode else "text-log"  # youtube-dl's rule

        outcome = "write(%r) OK" % payload
    except TypeError as e:
        outcome = "TypeError: %s" % e
    print("%-6s mode=%-6r -> %s" % (label, mode, outcome))
    return "TypeError" not in outcome


print("== BEFORE (HEAD) ==")
ok_before = scenario(load_class(HEAD_CAPTURE), "HEAD")
print("== AFTER (working tree) ==")
ok_after = scenario(load_class(CAPTURE), "fixed")

assert ok_after, "expected the fix to accept the youtube-dl write"

f.write("plain str")
f.writelines(["a\n", "b\n"])
assert isinstance(f.name, str)
assert "b" not in f.mode
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
